title.en: Draw it on the side asked for

brief.zh: c = 0 时，从左边那一带抽一个斑点；c = 1 时，从右边那一带抽。
brief.en: When c = 0, draw a blob from the region on the left; when c = 1, from the region on the right.

hint.zh: 同样的抽样，只是中心换了。中心能不能由 c 算出来？
hint.en: The same sampling, only with a different centre. Can the centre be worked out from c?

after.zh: 多给生成器一个条件输入，它就按要求画：这叫条件生成。「画一只猫」「画成水彩风格」这些文字提示，就是更复杂的条件。
after.en: Give the generator one more input, a condition, and it draws what is asked for: this is called conditional generation. Text prompts like "draw a cat" or "in watercolour" are just more elaborate conditions.

t.zh: 生成器画出来的东西是随机的。要让它按要求画，得多告诉它一点什么。
t.en: What a generator draws is random. To make it draw what is asked for, it has to be told something more.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：c = 0 时在左边那一带画斑点，c = 1 时在右边。
t.en: Your task in this level: when c = 0, draw the blob in the region on the left; when c = 1, on the right.

c.zh: 画哪边 c（0 左，1 右）
